body:
## Scope

W02.1b-I first fail-closed **start classifier** slice (P-a/P-b/P-c) under admission `SORI-NORMAL-STARTUP-20261028-391159f9` and accepted D01 FMT-PREP-r2 §9.2/§9.3 (sha256 3fdd3ddd…).

- `admininit.ClassifyStart(ctx, adminDir, dataRoot, hostID, Paths, last *PolicyObservation) StartClass` returns **S0, S6, S1, S2, S1c, S1d, S3**; every other state (S4, S5a, S5b, S7, S9, S10, unknown schema, unreadable store) maps to **S12 RO/HOLD**. `Writable` is true only for S3.
- Order: epoch absent → §9.2 S1/S2 only (keyring, policy/state and the `keys/`/`policy/` directories ignored whatever their state). Epoch present → invalid epoch / host id / keyring = **S0**; invalid policy/state, policy document installation ≠ epoch, or the carried RW-C1 §3.2 runtime checks (high_water below last observed revision; same revision, different digest) = **S6**; then pristine/unmarked/no-restore_state data = **S1c** (reason names the data root); store marker of another installation = **S1d** (checked before S3, K1d); LIVE + same host + same epoch + same cut = **S3**.
- `hostID` is an explicit required parameter, validated by the existing `ValidateHostID`; no configuration binding (W08/W09).
- P-a reuses the existing strict readers (`parseEpoch`, `parseKeyring`, `parsePolicyState`, `policyDocumentInstallation`) through `readTailAt` (openat O_NOFOLLOW, regular file, size cap) on directory descriptors.
- P-b: new `jobledger.InspectStartFacts` generalises `InspectInitState` to report facts (pristine, schema known, content-empty, marker fields, init-marker-only) instead of the three init outcomes. It never uses `Open`; when the WAL is empty and no journal exists it opens the file **immutable**, so the read creates and maps no `-wal`/`-shm`. The authority's pristine fact is taken from `Lstat` only (no SQLite open). `checkNoContent` now returns a typed `contentError` (same message) so content vs. read failure are distinguishable.
- **No write**: the classifier takes no lock, never opens a database for writing, never creates a pristine path, writes no WAL/schema/marker/admin file and has no MemoryStore fallback. Data-root facts are read first.

## Excluded

P-d real server/Discover, production startup wiring, L2 lock use, S9 activation, wire/proto/RPC, credentials/grants, A/R/C, W08/W09, any new owner scheme, cursor or ServerRoot.

## Evidence (seoy, go1.26.10 linux/amd64)

Old-red at 42ad443 (tests only, on base 2fa7f5e1): `go test -count=1 -run TestClassifyStart ./internal/admininit/`
```
internal/admininit/startup_linux_test.go:53:102: undefined: admininit.PolicyObservation
...
FAIL	github.com/HeaInSeo/sori/internal/admininit [build failed]
```
Green at cf4485d: `make test` exit 0 (17 packages ok), including
```
--- PASS: TestClassifyStartRows (3.62s)   (15 subtests: S0×4, S6, S1, S2, S1c×4, S1d, S12×3)
--- PASS: TestClassifyStartCompleteInitIsS3
--- PASS: TestClassifyStartFreshIsS1
--- PASS: TestClassifyStartLastObservedPolicy
ok  	github.com/HeaInSeo/sori/internal/admininit	coverage: 82.2% of statements
ok  	github.com/HeaInSeo/sori/jobledger	coverage: 73.9% of statements
```
`make lint` 0 issues (depguard + main), `make lint-security` 0 issues, `make vuln` exit 0, `gofmt -l .` empty, `go mod tidy -diff` clean, `go vet ./...` linux and `GOOS=darwin`, `GOOS=windows go vet` of the two packages ok.

All tests use real files and real SQLite in `t.TempDir()` via a complete `admininit.Init`. Every classification is wrapped in a no-write assertion: a snapshot of the admin area and the data root (path, mode, uid/gid, size, inode, mtime, ctime, SHA-256) before vs. after must be equal, sidecars included. An earlier iteration showed the plain `mode=ro` open updating/creating `-shm`/`-wal`; that is why the immutable open was added.

## Disclosed limits for review

- No two-process test: the classifier takes no lock and writes nothing, so it does not touch lock contention; L2 around it belongs to P-d.
- P3-FMT7 fd-based no-follow chmod: not applicable — the classifier performs no chmod.
- With a non-empty `-wal` or a `-journal` (crashed writer), `InspectStartFacts` uses SQLite's read-only recovery path, which may create/map `-shm` (the bookkeeping `InspectInitState` already documents). Not covered by a test.
- A non-empty but schema-less SQLite authority file is not detected as pristine (metadata only).
- Not implemented in this slice: the C.5.1 r4 K8-native admin-area check (owner ≠ server euid, mode & 022, access(W_OK)) and the §4.3 "high_water ≥ every policy revision the store references" check.
